# Prompt Pattern: AI Generate Page Object

Use this skill to create or update page object artifacts.

## Template
Generate page objects for: <feature-or-flow>
Context: <requirement/test-case refs>
Existing code: <paths optional>
UI evidence: <url/mockup/dom optional>

## Example
Generate page objects for: customer checkout flow
Context: TC-US-003-Checkout.md
Existing code: src/pages/CheckoutPage.ts
UI evidence: /checkout page DOM snapshot
